mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the copied DNA and membrane supply was most worthwhile because the sequence showed how they contribute to two cells with complete DNA copies.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the membrane supply was the least engaging moment: it was the only combination offered, though the picture of sacs moving to the surface helped explain it.

surprise.text: I didn't expect the new membrane to travel toward the surface in small sacs.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt entirely arbitrary, but combining fats and proteins to make membrane relied partly on the named ingredients and the offered pairing rather than explaining how the cell makes it.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how these unspecialized cells become different body-cell types, though the mostly forced combinations make me unsure how much choice there will be.
